Commentary.Commentary: It is a below par score on the board and with the deep batting that India possess, it seems to be a cakewalk in the park. However, South Africa wouldn't give up and go hard at the Asian side as it is a matter of qualifying for the semi-final. It is a two-paced track and a few wickets upfront might just put the Men in Blue in a dicey situation. Join us in a while for the chase.

They kept on mounting the pressure on South Africa, who crumbled under it. They ran through the lower middle order in a jiffy. The Indian bowling was right on the money today. Every bowler at least took a wicket. Bumrah was impressive and so was Ashwin on his return. Credit needs to be given to Virat Kohli for his field placings and bowling changes. He didn't let the Saffas off the hook with his aggressive captaincy. They lost eight wickets for 51 runs at the end and that tells you the story.

Top class performance from India and they are in a commanding position at the innings break. South Africa began sedately as the opening partnership was a decent one. Quinton de Kock played a good knock to score a half century but threw his wicket in the quest for quick runs. After that, the Proteas lost their way completely. AB de Villiers and David Miller were run out due to errors in judgement. You can't afford that at such a big stage and the Men in Blue grabbed the opportunities with both hands.

OUT! Total confusion once again! You can't even call these school boy errors. Length delivery around off, Duminy heaves it through the mid-wicket region. Kohli is quick to charge towards the ball. The batsmen want the second but they both hesitate to run. Kohli fumbles which makes Tahir go for it. He is sent back by Duminy but it's too late as the Indian skipper quickly collects the ball and throws it at the striker's end. Dhoni is quick to dislodge the bails and they start celebrating as the umpire goes upstairs to check for the run out. Replays show that Tahir was well outside and SOUTH AFRICA HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 191.
There is a run out appeal against Tahir. Seems gone to the naked eye.
Fuller into the stumps, Duminy tries to defend it on the off side but he ends up inside edging onto the pads.
Shortish around off, Duminy charges down the track and slaps it off the toe end towards the fielder at long off. No runs taken.
Third man comes inside the ring.
Another fuller delivery outside off, Tahir defends it really well to negotiate the last ball of the over.
Full outside off, Tahir drives it towards mid off and calls for a single. Duminy sends him back.
Another fuller delivery around off, Tahir drives it straight back to the bowler.
A sharp slower one on a very fuller length in the line of the stumps, Tahir somehow manages to defend it.
Short delivery into the batsman, Tahir ducks under it.
Yorker right on the money, Tahir digs it out towards the fielder at covers. Rohit Sharma collects it and throws the ball in the over to excite the crowd. They are all charged up.
Wide! Sprayed way down the leg side this time, Tahir still goes for it. Does not make contact and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Jasprit Bumrah comes back for a bowl.
Good length delivery outside off, Duminy tries to poke at it but he is beaten by the outside edge.
Four Leg Byes! Handy runs for South Africa! Back of a length delivery down the leg side, Duminy tries to clip it fine. Gets it off the thigh pad, past Dhoni for a boundary.
No he doesn't! Good length delivery angling into the batsman, Tahir slashes hard at it. Gets it off the outer half towards third man for a single.
Imran Tahir is the next man in. Can Kumar get the hat-trick?

OUT! Two in two for Bhuvi! Another outside edge brings about the downfall. The captaincy from Kohli is spot on as he had placed himself a bit wide at first slip. Back of a length delivery outside off, Morkel tries to push at it. Gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies towards Kohli who makes no mistake. Brilliant stuff from Bhuvneshwar and he is on a hat-trick.
Morne Morkel walks out to bat.

OUT! The bowling change works and Rabada has to walk back! Good length delivery and angling away. Kagiso tries to defend it on the leg side. Gets a thick outside edge on it and the ball flies towards the keeper. The ball carries and Dhoni dives towards his left to take a sharp catch. South Africa are even struggling to reach 200 here.
Good length delivery outside off, Rabada punches it towards the fielder at point.
Bumrah was ready to bowl but Virat Kohli changed his decision. He has given Bhuvneshwar Kumar a go with the ball.
Rabada stays in his crease and pushes it towards long on for a single.
Duminy drives it towards mid off for a single.
Duminy cuts but only manages to find the diving Jadeja at point.
Quicker around middle and leg, the ball skids off the deck. Duminy cannot defend it and the ball goes onto rap the pads. The players appeal but the umpire says no as it was going down leg.
A bit short around off, Duminy pushes it towards the fielder at point.
Fuller around leg, Duminy pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.
Ravichandran Ashwin is back on.
Fullish delivery angling away from leg, Rabada gets behind the line of the ball to defend it. A good over from Jasprit Bumrah. He is firing on all cylinders at the time when it matters the most.
FOUR! Short delivery and Rabada pounces on it this time. Plays the pull shot over the square leg region for a boundary.
Yorker just around off, Rabada blocks it away towards the fielder at mid off.
Length delivery around middle and leg, Rabada defends it neatly this time.
Welcomes Rabada with the short stuff! Dug in short around leg, Rabada sways away from the line of the delivery.
Kagiso Rabada comes out to bat.

OUT! Bumrah gets his second! Low full toss around leg stump, Phehlukwayo tries to get his bat down in time but he fails to make contact. Gets hit flush on the back pad and the players start appealing for an LBW. The umpire stays undisturbed. Kohli after consulting his players, opts for the review. Replays show that it pitched on leg, impact was in line and it was going to hit the stumps. So it was plumb and the umpire has to change his decision. Both the teams have got their reviews right.
Virat Kohli opts to take a review against Phehlukwayo. It is regarding an LBW decision. Is it missing the leg stump?
Powerplay 3 has been signaled by the umpire. Maximum of five fielders are allowed outside the circle till the end of the innings.
Full length ball outside off, Phehlukwayo drives it crisply through covers. A run taken.
Slower delivery around off, Andile pushes it with soft hands to covers.
On a fuller length on off, Andile stays back and defends it.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Phehlukwayo pushes at it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Slower delivery outside off, dabbed neatly to third man for a single.
Short of a length outside off, Phehlukwayo punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar comes back into the attack.
Fullish delivery, Andile eases it to long off for a single.
Another front foot defense by Phehlukwayo to the tossed up delivery.
Andile strides forward and defends this one solidly.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Tossed up outside off, JP plays it towards backward point. Duminy initially calls for the run and Phehlukwayo responds. Then, the southpaw sends him back. The shy at the bowler's end misses. Chaos at its height.

FOUR! Streaky runs! A bit short outside off, spinning away. Duminy goes for the cut but gets an outside edge past the slip fielder for a boundary. So we have finally seen a boundary as it has come after ages.
Ravichandran Ashwin to bowl the next over.
On a fuller length this time, played with an open face to backward point.
This time he connects. Back of a length outside off, Duminy punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Slower delivery this time, JP cuts it to point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Duminy ends up chopping it besides the pitch. It is a slow track and he is finding it tough to time his shots. Boundaries have dried up for the Proteas too.
In the channel outside off, left alone.

Close shave! Fuller length ball around off, Phehlukwayo plays it with an angled bat to point and takes on Jadeja. The Indian is quick to get to his left and fires in a throw at the bowler's end but misses. Had it hit, it would have been close.
Shortish outside off, JP cuts it hard but finds point.
On a length on middle and off, JP shuffles a touch and clips it to mid on. A bit risky to play like that. Can be a candidate for an LBW if he misses those.
Andile Phehlukwayo strides out to the middle.

OUT! Morris bites the dust! India are right on top and are dictating the terms at The Oval. Dug on a shortish length around off, Morris is drawn into the pull but is late into his shot. Ends up getting a top edge and the ball spoons towards mid-wicket. Bhuvneshwar Kumar moves to his right and pouches it safely. First wicket for Bumrah in the ICC Champions Trophy.
Full toss on off, Chris mistimes his drive to mid off. Failed to capitalize on that.
Full on off, Duminy wrists it to wide mid on for a single.
On a length and angling away from JP. He plays it with an open face to point.
Wide! Starts his new spell with a loosener down the leg side, JP looks to glance but misses.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on.
Well bowled! Brilliant yorker on middle and leg, Morris digs it out towards short mid-wicket.
Good length delivery outside off, JP steers it to third man for a single.
Morris hops back and works this one around the corner for a single.

That could have been close! Fullish delivery on middle and off, Duminy mistimes his drive back down the track. Pandya manages to get a bit of boot on it. The ball just goes wide of the stumps towards mid off. A single taken. Had that hit the stumps, things could have been interesting as Morris was backing up.
Fuller length delivery on off, Duminy pushes at it but gets it off the inner half to the left side of the bowler.
That's a peach of a delivery! Angles across a length delivery from JP. He feels for it but is beaten all ends up.
Duminy taps it to point and steals a quick single. Jadeja ends with 10-0-39-1! A brilliant comeback by him after letting 22 in his first four overs.
Quicker one this time, JP shuffles across to work it across but is struck on the thigh pad.
Fullish outside off, Morris drills it past extra cover for a run.
Duminy uses his feet and clips it to long on for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Not out! Tossed up delivery, Duminy drives it back to Jadeja. He deflects it back to the stumps at the bowler's end. It is referred upstairs but the replays show that Morris was aware of the situation. Made his ground in time.
The umpire has gone upstairs to check for a run out appeal against Chris Morris.
Straying on the hips, worked to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length on off, Morris rises up on his toes and defends it to covers.
Fullish delivery, stroked to covers.
Chris Morris is the new man in.

Time for Drinks. India have turned the tide completely since the last drinks break and they are currently on top of their game. South Africa will need a good partnership now to post a decent total on the board.

OUT! Dragged on! South Africa have lost the plot completely. Off cutter outside off, on a a shorter length. Du Plessis stays back and looks to force it through covers. However, he gets a thick inside edge and the ball goes back to shatter the furniture behind. Poor shot and another one goes down. He got out in a similar fashion against Pakistan. He repeats his mistake and half of the South African side is back to the hut.
Shortish and angling away. Duminy glides it behind point for a single.
Back of a length delivery on off, Duminy taps it to point.
Slower through the air outside off, Duminy pushes it to point. A run taken.
Faf eases this one through mid off for a single.
Floated outside off, Dumniny plays it with an open face to point. A run taken.
Fullish this time, turned to mid-wicket again.
Tossed up delivery, defended to mid-wicket.
Landed outside off, stroked through mid off for a single.
Faf works this one round the corner for a run.
Similar length delivery on off, du Plessis rises on his toes and defends it.
Short of a length ball on middle, Duminy tucks it to short mid-wicket and sets off. Pandya runs to his left but fails to collect it cleanly. A run taken.
Angling into the hips, clipped through square leg for a single.
WIDE! Dug in really short this time, Faf thinks of going for the pull but it was too high for him as he lets it through. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Length delivery angling into the batsman, Faf du Plessis stays in his crease and defends it really well.
Fuller around off, du Plessis drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Hardik Pandya is brought back for a bowl.
Floated delivery, driven crisply through coves for a run.
A bit shorter, punched to extra cover.
Tossed up delivery, pushed to covers.
Comes down the track and works it to long on for a single.

Not out! Tossed up delivery, spinning in. Duminy goes for the sweep but seems to have missed it as he gets rapped on the pads. Huge appeal for an LBW and up goes the umpire's finger. Duminy opts for the review straightaway. The Hot Spot show that JP had gloved it so the on-field call is reversed. He survives.
JP Duminy has gone upstairs to review an LBW decision against him. He seems really confident as he was way quick to go for the review.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A bit short, clipped to mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Duminy taps it to covers and sets off. The throw is at the striker's end but it is a bit wide. It is all happening in the middle.
Faf pushes it to point for a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
JP Duminy is the next man in.

OUT! Huge mix-up and Miller is the one who suffers. Flatter delivery on off, du Plessis is squared up a touch and gets an outside edge towards short third man. He takes off and Miller responds. However, they both hesitate but Miller keeps on running. Faf recognizes that he won't be able to make it to the other end, so turns back and dives in to make his ground. The throw is a bit wayward at the striker's end and Dhoni smartly lets it through. Kohli is quick to spot it. Collects it and runs to the stumps to dislodge the bails. The decision is referred upstairs. Replays show that Faf was the one who returned to the striker's end first. Miller is sold down the river by Faf and he walks back disappointed.
Big mix-up. The umpire goes upstairs to check which player has been run out as both ran towards the striker's end.
Ravichandran Ashwin is back for a bowl.
Floated on off, defended solidly.
Faf uses his feet and wrists it to wide long on for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single. Miller is off the mark.
Floated outside off, Miller drives it to extra cover where the fielder misfields a touch but no harm done.
David Miller walks out to the middle.

OUT! The big fish departs! A bit short around off, du Plessis places it towards point and takes off. AB de Villiers responds and hares to the danger end. Hardik Pandya moves to his right and returns an accurate throw to MS Dhoni. He collects the ball and takes the bails off in a flash as AB dives full length to come back. It is referred upstairs and India look confident. The replays show that the skipper is short of his crease. A big breakthrough this. AB de Villiers' poor run continues.
The umpires have gone upstairs to check for a run out appeal against AB de Villiers.
Tossed up delivery, de Villiers drives it to sweeper cover for a run.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Back of a length outside off, de Villiers adjusts and cuts it to third man. Rohit cuts it off. Two runs taken.
This one shoots off the deck after pitching. Faf taps it late to point and takes off. Jadeja is quick to get across but misses his shy at the bowler's end. A run results.
Slower delivery outside off, de Villiers dabs it behind point for a run.
Brilliant bowling from Bumrah. Gets it in the blockhole. Du Plessis gets his toes out of the way and jams it to mid on. A quick single taken.
Good length delivery outside off, dabbed neatly to third man for a run.
Jasprit Bumrah is called back on.
Flatter delivery outside off, stays a bit low. Faf adjusts well to punch it to covers.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.
Fired in on middle, Faf is squared up a touch as he outside edges it to short third man.
Flatter delivery, du Plessis punches it to the left of Jadeja. He makes a half-stop as the ball deflects to mid off.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Tossed up delivery, de Villiers makes room and eases it to long off for a single.
Similar length delivery outside off, AB chips down the track and hits it hard with a horizontal bat to sweeper cover. A single taken.
Shortish delivery outside off, de Villiers rises on his toes and cuts it to point.
Wide! Short and outside off, de Villiers shapes to play the ramp shot but it is high. Wide signaled for height.
Back of a length outside off, du Plessis forces it uppishly through point. Kumar hares to his left in the deep to keep it to a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! On a length and slanting down the leg side, du Plessis just has to get some bat on it. He does and gets it fine past the keeper for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, dabbed neatly to third man for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Fractionally overpitched outside off, AB de Villiers crunches it through covers. It is the shorter side of the ground and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Shortish around off, du Plessis punches it straight to the fielder at point. An eventful over for India.
Fuller around off, du Plessis pushes it back to the bowler.
Pushed through the cover region for a single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.
The skipper, Ab de Villiers strides out to bat. He will be eager to showcase his skills in today's do-or-die encounter.

OUT! Jadeja gets his man! Floats this one outside off and spinning in this time. De Kock tries to sweep it on the leg side but he misses it completely. The ball goes through and disturbs the stumps. Jadeja is excited and Quinton de Kock for the first time has failed to convert a half century into a ton against India. A big, big wicket for India.
Fuller around middle and leg, Quinton de Kock goes for the reverse sweep. Gets an inside edge onto the pads but Jadeja is appealing for an LBW. The umpire denies it.
Short around off, du Plessis dabs it towards the fielder at backward point.

Super Jaddu! Fuller around off, de Kock cuts it hard and tries to get it past backward point. Jadeja the fielder there dives to his left and makes a fantastic stop to save a certain boundary. A single taken.
Fuller outside off, de Kock drives it through covers for a couple.
Short outside off, du Plessis guides it towards third man for a single.
14th ODI fifty for Quinton de Kock.

Short and wide outside off, Quinton de Kock punches it through point for a single. His merry run against India continues. After a comparatively slow start, Quinton is getting in the flow to get another big one.
Short outside off, pulled through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Short into the hips, de Kock clips it towards the fielder at short fine leg.
Faf du Plessis punches it through covers for a single.
Faf du Plessis drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller around off, de Kock tries to clip it on the leg side. Gets a leading edge through extra cover for a single.
Short and wide outside off, du Plessis punches it through the cover region. Shikhar Dhawan cuts it off and saves a run for his team.
Fuller into the pads, Quinton drives it towards long on for a single.
Flicked to the mid-wicket region for a single.
Fuller around leg, clipped through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Fuller length delivery outside off, de Kock punches it towards the fielder at point.
Fuller around off, Quinton crunches it down the ground but unluckily ends up hitting the stumps at the non-striker's end.
Back of a length delivery outside off, du Plessis opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for a single.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side, du Plessis fails to clip it through. The umpire signals it as a wide. 100 up for South Africa!
Length delivery outside off, du Plessis flays at it but misses.
Hardik Pandya is back on.
Dabbed towards point for a single
Short and angling into the pads, worked through square leg for a single.
Again full into the pads, de Kock clips it towards mid-wicket.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Fires this one down the leg side, Quinton helps it through square leg for a single.
Short outside off, du Plessis pushes it through covers for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Wide! Quicker way down the leg side, du Plessis lets it through the keeper. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Fuller into the pads, du Plessis blocks it away.
Around off, worked through the square leg region. Quick running between the wickets and a bit late reaction from Kedar Jadhav allows them to take two.
Fuller around off, de Kock drives it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Typical Quinton! Fuller around leg, de Kock whips it powerfully through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Fuller around off, du Plessis clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Fuller around off, du Plessis drives it through covers for a single.
Short outside off, punched through the cover region for a couple.
Quicker outside off, de Kock defends it on the off side for a quick single.
Around off, driven through covers for a single.
Fuller around leg, Quinton reverse sweeps through the backward point region for a single.
Fuller around off, punched through point for a single.
Full around off, de Kock blocks it away.

Fuller down the leg side, Quinton fails to clip it through. The ball brushes his pads on its way to Dhoni who cannot hold onto it. Had Dhoni collected it, it could have been a stumping chance as de Kock overbalanced a touch after attempting the shot. No harm done in the end.
Fuller around off, Faf du Plessis drives it towards long on for a single to get off the mark.
Faf du Plessis comes out to bat. A leg slip in place for him.

Time for Drinks. A decent start from South Africa but India will be happy to see the back of the in-form Amla. The Men in Blue need to keep chipping away at the wickets to build more pressure on the Proteas.

OUT! Ashwin has got the breakthrough India needed! Flatter around off at a quicker pace, the ball skids on after pitching. Amla looks to cut it hard but gets a thick edge on it. Dhoni behind the stumps takes a sharp catch to send the dangerous Amla back to the hut. Ashwin has struck in his comeback game and has drawn first blood. Hashim departs after a good start to his innings.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Good shot! Fuller around off, Amla gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it wide of the bowler through the mid off region for a boundary.
Wide! Fires this one down the leg side, Amla steps in line and lets the ball through. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Quicker around off, de Kock gets it towards mid-wicket off the inner half.
Here comes the reverse sweep. Fuller around off, de Kock cannot time his reverse sweep well as he finds the fielder at short third man.
Four singles in a row. Amla punches it towards deep point for a single.
Again around middle and off to Quinton, he clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Short outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Angling into the pads, Quinton clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja is given the ball.
Fuller around off, the batsman charges down the track and drives it towards long off for a single to keep strike.
Short around off, Amla shuffles across and flicks it through the square leg region for a single.
Tossed up around off, de Kock uses his feet and clips it through mid on for a quick single.
Fuller outside off, de Kock pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Amla stays deep in his crease and punches it on the off side for a quick single.
De Kock punches it through covers for a single.
Good comeback by Pandya! Yorker right on the money, Amla digs it out safely.
FOUR! Another predetermined shuffle and Amla gets rewarded! Length delivery around off, angling in. Amla moves way across and pulls it off the inner half through the fine leg region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla tries to run it down but he cannot beat the fielder at short third man.
Another shortish delivery around off, Amla defends it towards the fielder at backward point.
Back of a length delivery outside, another shuffle and Amla goes for the pull. Misses it and gets hit on the thigh pad.
SIX! Amla is done with his waiting! Fuller delivery outside off, Amla shuffles across and picks it up quickly to send the ball deep into the square leg stands for a maximum.
De Kock stays deep in his crease and defends it well.
Shorter around off, Amla charges down the track and clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
De Kock clips it through mid on for a quick single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on middle, clipped to mid-wicket.
Full around off, de Kock jams it towards mid off.

DROPPED! Fuller delivery around off, Amla drives it straight back to the bowler. Pandya is a bit late to react in his followthrough and he cannot hold onto the ball coming straight to him. A fielder of his standard should have taken it. Amla is lucky to survive.

Run out chance missed! Length delivery outside off, de Kock drives it towards mid off and rushes for a single. Kohli comes steaming in and has an underarm shy at the stumps. He misses and had he hit, de Kock was gone by a mile. 50 up for South Africa.
Fuller around off, Amla punches it towards the fielder at mid-wicket for a single.
Third man comes inside the circle.
Short delivery outside off, Amla watches the ball go through to the keeper.
Very full in the line of the stumps, Amla goes back and clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, Amla drives it towards the fielder at mid off.

FOUR! Poor bowling! Sprayed down the leg side, de Kock is quick to read the loosener as he sways back a bit and pulls it past the diving short fine leg fielder for a boundary. Quinton won't miss out on those.
Floats this one in the line of the stumps, the batsman blocks it out late.
De Kock stays in his crease and flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Outside off, Amla sweeps it towards short fine leg for a single.
Fuller around off, de Kock drives it down the ground. Ashwin is late to react which allows the batsmen to run a single.
Fuller around middle, Amla clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
De Kock stays deep in his crease and tries to dab it to third man but gets a bottom edge on it.
Good length delivery outside off, Amla runs it down towards third man. A run taken.
De Kock clips it through square leg for a single.

Length delivery outside off, Quinton dabs it towards point and scampers for a single. Jadeja comes charging in and has a shy at the striker's end and he misses. That allows the batsmen to run another one on an overthrow. Two runs in total.
Amla pulls it towards fine leg for a single.

Leg bye! Good length delivery on middle and off, de Kock tries to clip it on the leg side. Fails to clip on the leg side and gets rapped on the pads. The ball goes towards the short third man region for a leg bye.
Hardik Pandya is brought on for a bowl.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Now a maximum of four fielders are allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Desperation from Amla! A touch short outside off, Amla looks to force it through covers but misses it completely. Good take by Dhoni behind the stumps. A nice start from Ashwin.
Slower through the air this time, Amla shapes to go downtown but adjusts in the end to defend it.
Wide! Down the leg side, Amla lets it go.
Flatter delivery on off, Amla punches it towards mid on. Kohli moves across to his left from short mid-wicket, dives and makes a good stop.
Tossed up outside off, spinning in. Worked to the leg side.
A bit short outside of, Amla punches it sweetly with the spin but picks out the man at covers.
Fullish on middle and leg, de Kock turns it through square leg for a run.
Ravichandran Ashwin is introduced into the attack.
Fuller length ball around off, defended down the track.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Slower delivery on the pads, de Kock goes for the sweep but gets it off the inner half to short fine leg. Bumrah dives to his left and saves certain runs for his side. Only a run taken.

On a length outside off, Hashim shuffles across and looks to turn it through mid-wicket. Ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls towards the slip region. A quick single taken as the throw at the striker's end misses.

Brilliant bowling from Kumar. Cut Amla into two halves. Good length delivery outside off, shapes in a touch. Amla pushes at it with minimal foot movement but the ball goes through the gap between his bat and pad. It wasn't far from the off stump.
Shortish delivery on middle and off, de Kock works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower delivery outside off, driven crisply to mid off.
Full toss outside off, Amla mistimes it to mid on. Failed to capitalize on that.

A loud shout for an LBW denied! Length delivery on leg stump, angling in. De Kock in his usual way shuffles a long way and looks to tuck it fine. Misses to get rapped on the pads. A confident shout from Bumrah but the umpire shakes his head. The replays show that it may have pitched outside leg. The height was also a factor.
Good length ball around off, Quinton stays back and places it to point. Good tight bowling from Bumrah.
Fuller length ball on off, de Kock drives it to mid on.
On a good length outside off, Amla shuffles across and tucks it to fine leg for a run.
Three in a row! Kumar is right on the money. Angles across a length delivery from de Kock who pokes at it tentatively but gets beaten all ends up. End of a testing over.
A play and a miss again! Length delivery on off, a bit of extra bounce on that. De Kock pushes at it with minimal foot movement but once again gets foxed. This is good bowling from Kumar.
Shortish delivery, angling away from de Kock. He goes for the pull but gets beaten.
Short of a length delivery outside off, de Kock shuffles and pushes at it but gets it off the inner half to mid-wicket.
Wide slip in place now where a normal fourth slip fielder would be standing. Deep backward point also in position.
Good length delivery outside off, steered to third man for a single.
Shortish delivery, de kock moves inside the line and mistimes his pull to fine leg.
Good length outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
FOUR! Crisp! Short of a length outside off and room on offer, Amla rises up on his toes and punches it through point for an elegant boundary.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Good call Amla! Short of a length ball on middle and off, de Kock turns it towards Yuvraj at mid-wicket. A slight fumble from Yuvraj and Quinton thinks of taking him on. However, Amla is quick to send him back as Yuvraj is quick to recover and he has a shy at the striker's end. De kock makes it back in time as Dhoni clips the bails.
Good length delivery on off, de Kock shuffles a touch and defends it with soft hands towards the bowler.
Shortish delivery angling away, de Kock glides it to backward point.
Back of a length outside off, Amla punches it to mid off.

Similar length delivery outside off, Amla punches it towards Jadeja at point. Looks for a run but Jadeja is sharp as a hawk in that region. Picks the ball cleanly as Amla returns back. However, he misses his shy at the striker's end.
Back of a length outside off, Amla punches it sweetly but finds the man at covers. The track looks conducive for strokeplay.
Short of a length on middle, de Kock shuffles a touch and turns it to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Length delivery down the leg side, de Kock moves forward and nudges it fine. Beats Dhoni and earns a boundary for himself.
Fullish delivery on off, defended off the front foot.
Straight once again, Quinton nudges it to fine leg for a run.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Amla wrists it to mid on for a single.
Short of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to mid off.

Close shave! Back of a length delivery around the hips, Amla rises up on his toes as he looks to tuck it away but is struck on the thigh pad. Amla loses sight of the ball as he moves back to cover his stumps. He leaves a bit of gap between his legs but luckily, the ball rolls past the off stump.
Back of a length on leg stump, de Kock shuffles a touch and works it around the corner for a single.
FOUR! Straight as an arrow! Length delivery on off, de Kock leans forward and strokes it past the bowler. Pure timing on that and the ball whistles to the fence.
Straying on the pads, turned through square leg for an easy run and he will retain the strike.
On a length on the same line, de Kock stays back and defends it. Kumar is bowling on this channel as the leg side boundaries are big at the Oval.
Fullish on middle and leg, de Kock nudges it through backward square leg. Good running between the wickets allows the batsmen to come back for two.
Wide! Sprays it down the leg side, Quinton comes inside the line and lets it go.

A direct hit would have been close! Full length delivery outside off, Amla drives it towards mid off and sets off. Kohli moves across to his right and attacks the ball. Loses a bit of balance as the throw misses the target by a big margin at the bowler's end.
Fullish delivery outside off, Amla leans ahead a touch and plays it with an open face to point.
Back of a length outside off, Amla stays back and punches it nicely to covers.
Another full length ball on middle and off, de Kock lunges forward in defense. Tidy start from India.
Fullish delivery on off, Quinton leans forward and pushes it to mid off.
Good length delivery on leg stump, de Kock looks to play it across but is struck on the thigh pad.
On a length on off, Quinton shuffles a touch and tucks it in front of square on the leg side. Looks for a run but Yuvraj is quick to attack the ball to deny it.
Similar length delivery outside off, Amla cuts it uppishly to third man. A single taken.
Length delivery on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
On a fuller length outside off again, drawing Amla forward. He pushes at it but gets an edge towards second slip. The fielder dives to his right and slows down the pace. A run taken.
Fullish delivery outside off, Amla comes forward confidently and defends it to covers. He is looking solid.
Fullish delivery outside off, holding its line. Amla covers his off stump and sees it through safely.
Fuller length delivery around off, shaping in a touch. Amla plants his front foot forward and blocks it.
Length delivery on middle and off, Amla camps back and defends it solidly down the track.
Good length delivery on off, de Kock pushes at it but gets an inside edge to square leg. A run taken and de Kock is away.
Wide! Kumar starts with a loosener down the leg side, de Kock gets inside the line and lets it through. Very unlike Kumar at the start. He is right on the money usually.

The national anthems of both the teams are done and dusted. Now, the players and umpires are making their way out in the middle. Hashim Amla and Quinton De Kock will open the batting for South Africa. Bhuvneshwar Kumar has been handed the responsibility with the first new ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...

South Africa skipper, Ab de Villiers says stats favour the chasing team but he doesn't mind batting first. Mentions that they batted against Sri Lanka and are excited to put up a good total on the board. Feels that their batsmen need to communicate and plan the innings better. Opines that Virat is a good man and he gets along well with him. Reckons that their is a lot of passion and dedication when you play for your country. Announces that they have got one change. ANDILE PHEHLUKWAYO comes in for Wayne Parnell.

India skipper, Virat Kohli says that he will bowl first. Reckons that after looking at the last game and the trend in the tournament, he feels that it is better to field first. Informs that the wicket should remain the same throughout the game. Feels that knowing the target would help them when they come out to bat. Mentions that they have been batting well but they failed to defend it which made the total they made look 15-20 runs short in the previous game. Emphasis on the changes - RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN comes in place of Umesh Yadav.
TOSS - INDIA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD!

On the other hand, the top ranked side in the world were humbled in their last match by Pakistan. Unlike India, their batting is a bit of worry. In search of setting a huge target, their middle order lost the plot. Better planning is the need of the hour for them. Their bowling is their point of strength and they will bank on it to come good against an explosive Indian side. Thankfully, the skies are clear at present but no one can predict the weather in England. If this game is a wash out, India will book their spot in the semi-final due to a superior net run-rate.

Hello and a warm welcome to the do-or-die encounter between India and South Africa at The Oval in London. It is a virtual quarter-final and both sides will be aiming to put their best foot forward. The Men in Blue were shocked by Sri Lanka in their previous game and it might just prove to be the wake-up call they needed. Their bowlers got smashed all around the park on a placid track. Playing Ashwin might be a good ploy as he has a good record against left-handers and the Proteas have three of them in their top six.
